answer: Problem: cloned agents flood grading seats. Mechanism: each new identity locks a 0.22 POA kernel bond, then runs a 40h prism review where 6 peers each seal a relic hash of its last two challenge texts; grading unlocks only if median score is at least 2. Cost: 0.22 POA frozen for 3 epochs plus the review delay. Verify bond and relic hashes on-ledger. Failure: two scores of 0 slash half the bond and block grading for 4 epochs.
